newsitem.title: UK: Wickes plc like for like sales up 14 pct.
newsitem.headline: Wickes plc like for like sales up 14 pct.

text.p: Wickes Plc, the home improvement products retailer, said on Thursday its like-for-like sales in the 17 weeks to April 26 was up 14 percent on last year.
Total sales, including new store space, was up 20 percent, said the chairman Michael von Brentano in the annual general meeting statement.

The group, which was hit last year by widespread internal accounting discrepencies that led to a boardroom shake-out and massive profit write-offs, said returning to profitability remained the paramount objective. "I am confident 'New Wickes', under the leadership of Bill Grimsey, will meet our expectations," said the chairman.

Wickes said it had benefited from the recent good weather and the improved UK housing market. Borrowings remained under control and for the 10 weeks since the completion of the recent rights issue its average weekly net debt averaged 24 million.
